narrative.benchmark_md: Against the engagement-locked peer set (Rule R7) — Pershing Square Capital Management, Third Point LLC, Starboard Value LP, ValueAct Capital and Millennium Management — Elliott scores above the peer median in all four pillars and in 16 of 17 categories. The four activist peers cluster as P1-strong (governance/strategy 3.0-3.5) and P2-servicing-light (CRM-less, 1.8-2.5). Millennium Management is the lead competitor and the multi-manager outlier: its P3 Automation (4.0) and P4 Analytics/Architecture (4.0) reflect a Google Cloud platform with Vertex AI and BigQuery serving 300+ investment teams and ~1,200 technologists (re-validated June 2026), and it is the bar Elliott's enterprise data and AI estate trails. Starboard Value is the direct precedent that Salesforce can be an activist target — reinforcing that Elliott's relationship with Salesforce is as an investor (Jesse Cohn's 2023 stake, E-058), not a user. The implication: Elliott's P2 servicing and personalization opportunity is a leapfrog (peers are equally CRM-less), while its P4 data and AI opportunity is competitive catch-up to Millennium's bar.
